after the end of the cemiplimab infusion.", "severity": "minor"}, {"title": "Inconsistent AE reporting window", "page": 77, "quote": "record all AEs that occur from the time the informed consent is patient’s last study visit, whichever comes first.", "severity": "minor"}, {"title": "Inconsistent sample size calculation", "page": 82, "quote": "For Group 1, 50 patients are required to provide at "page": 82, "quote": "For Group 2, 80 patients are required to provide at least 85% power to reject a null hypothesis of an ORR of 20% at a 2-sided significance level of 5% if the true ORR is 35%.", "severity": "major"}, {"title": "Inconsistent stopping rule", "page": 83, "quote": "If accrual to Group 1 is <16 patients in 6 months, Group 1 will be closed for inability to achieve target accrual. The start of this 6-month period will be the date that ninth patient is enrolled in Group 2.", "severity": "major"}, {"title": "Inconsistent primary analysis timing", "page": 82, "quote": "For primary analysis, the last patient in a group will have the opportunity to be followed for approximately 57 weeks, including 27 weeks (cycles 1 to 3) for response, plus an additional 30 weeks (cycles 4 to 6) for DOR.", "severity": "major"}, {"title": "Inconsistent primary analysis timing", "page": 82, "quote": "If the last patient(s) has early EOS, the timing of data cut will be determined by the enrollment date of the last enrolled patient who remains on study (first dose + approximately 57 weeks).", "severity": "major"}, {"title": "Inconsistent analysis sets", "page": 84, "quote": "The full analysis set (FAS) includes all patients for each group who have passed screening and are deemed to be eligible for this study.", "severity": "major"}]}
